name: Tonic | 10mg Beverage | Fizz Crisp Apple
description:
10mg THC Beverage
Enjoy the refreshing taste of Tonic Fizz in Crisp Apple. This sparkling cannabis-infused beverage delivers the crisp and sweet flavor of freshly picked apples, perfectly paired with a light effervescence. Infused with 10mg THC per bottle, it provides a gentle, uplifting high that promotes relaxation and enhances social moments. Perfect for daytime sipping, Tonic Fizz Crisp Apple is a flavorful and convenient way to elevate your cannabis experience.
